name: BRO wrapper callback double-mint SolvBTC drain
summary: The BRO wrapper's mint() pulls the whole ERC-3525 position in with safeTransferFrom, whose onERC721Received callback mints BRO for the received value before the outer mint() mints it again. Looping burn-then-mint doubled the attacker's BRO each round; the unbacked BRO was then exchanged for SolvBTC from the treasury's exchange.
notes: The anchor is a small first run of the double mint by the same EOA (4.26 BRO subscribed through BRORouter, burned and minted back as 8.52); it depleted no priced asset but is the earliest exercise. The beacon pointed at the vulnerable implementation from its creation, so the BRO proxy's deployment is the reset.

Loss is the SolvBTC the treasury Safe 0xfb2dc242 released through exchange 0x1e610172 for 165,592,064 unbacked BRO; the BRO it received and the attacker's leftover BRO are not counted. The earlier txs moved only BRO.
